changes.newValue: Two fixes: (1) TutorialCoachTargeting mine_target now searches UI/FireButton as fallback so the panel repositions correctly during mining. (2) SidescrollMining Instructions label moved from offset_top=100 to offset_top=200, below the drone drop zone.

snapshot.title: Fix mining scene popup obscured by drone drop zone
snapshot.description: Tester feedback: 'The mining was interesting, but the mission popup is directly under where the drones drop, so its hard to tell whats happening.' The tutorial/info panel overlaps the drone animation area during mining. Reposition the panel to not conflict with the drone drop zone.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Tutorial/info panel does not overlap the drone drop animation area during mining
Player can see both the drone dropping and the mission info simultaneously
